Adrighem & Aldibiki — Fleet Maintenance Manual

Cairo, 29 September 2026

Fleet Maintenance Manual

1. Daily checks

1.1 Before starting the engine
Walk around the crane and look for leaks under the carrier, loose bolts on the outrigger beams and 
damage to the tyres. Check the engine oil, the coolant and the hydraulic tank level with the boom 
fully retracted, because the level reading changes when cylinders are extended. Walk around the 
crane and look for leaks under the carrier, loose bolts on the outrigger beams and damage to the 
tyres. Check the engine oil, the coolant and the hydraulic tank level with the boom fully retracted, 
because the level reading changes when cylinders are extended.

 Hydraulics

 Hoses
 Cylinders and seals

 Structure

 Boom sections
 Outrigger pads
